sloka: त इमे बहु साहस्रैः अनेकैः बहु विक्रमैः ।आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः ॥४-४०-७॥
transliteration: ta ime bahu sāhasraiḥ anekaiḥ bahu vikramaiḥ ।āgatā vānarā ghorā daitya dānava saṁnibhāḥ ॥4-40-7॥

translations.english: 'Dreadful monkeys who resemble demons have arrived along with thousands of fierce fighters.
